name: Sonix
tagline: Sonix is an automated transcription service that converts audio and video files to text in over 40 languages with high accuracy. It includes an in-browser editor for correcting transcripts, automated translation, and subtitle export. Journalists, researchers, and podcasters use it to process hours of audio in minutes.
